sanskrit_verse:
भोगांश् च दद्याद् विप्रेभ्यो वसूनि विविधानि च /
अक्षयो ’यं निधी राज्ञां यद् विप्रेषूपपादितम् // YajñS_1.315
transliteration: bhogāṃś ca dadyād viprebhyo vasūni vividhāni ca / akṣayo 'yaṃ nidhī rājñāṃ yad vipreṣūpapāditam
sph_interpretive_translation: The King shall bestow enjoyments and diverse valuables upon the Brahmanas; this is an imperishable treasure among Kings, that which is established in the Brahmanas.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through alignment with Brahmanic consciousness
Causation arises from sacrificial generosity, not extraction
Capacity-based responsibility requires rulers to sustain spiritual intelligentsia
Restoration logic mandates wealth circulation to preserve sovereignty
Consciousness alignment occurs when material power serves spiritual expansion
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler possesses surplus THEN allocate portion to Brahmana institutions
IF societal imbalance detected THEN increase offerings to Vedic scholars
IF kingdom stability threatened THEN verify Brahmana nourishment protocols
IF economic growth observed THEN ensure proportional sharing with spiritual class
IF governance misaligned THEN restore dharmic wealth distribution mechanisms
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating state resource allocation, Supreme Courts must recognize that constitutional legitimacy derives from sustaining those who uphold Veda. Redistribution policies are not discretionary but mandatory for sovereign continuity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that royal prosperity originates in Brahmana satisfaction. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows neglect leads to collapse. Responsibility lies in maintaining alignment, not inflicting correction. True Nyāya restores flow between temporal and spiritual orders.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate royal offering ceremonies to realign kingly consciousness
Establish regular review of state-Brahmana wealth exchange ratios
Deploy ritual auditors to assess dharmic fiscal compliance
Activate community śraddhā programs to restore proper giving habits
Reintegrate administrative systems around Vedic value circulation
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism: Giving to the Brahmanas constitutes eternal treasure of Kings. This is Dharma executed by Divine Will alone. There is no punishment here—only alignment with Sanatana Truth. Consciousness itself judges rightly when nourished properly.
